title: TransembleNet: Enhancing Species and Vector Mosquito Classification through Transfer Learning Base Ensemble Model
description: Problem Statement: Current mosquito vector classification methods struggle with accuracy, computational cost, and imbalanced datasets. Aim: To enhance classification accuracy in imbalanced datasets using an optimized ensemble model. Methodology: Developed an ensemble model combining InceptionV3, ResNet-50, and VGG-16 with transfer learning. The approach utilized fine-tuning and robust augmentation techniques to address class imbalance and reduce computational complexity.

title: Multi-label Emotion and Sentiment Detection from Bengali Text Using Hybrid Deep Learning Model
description: Problem Statement: Limited datasets and accurate models hinder multi-label emotion and sentiment detection in Bengali. Aim: To develop an annotated dataset and a hybrid deep-learning model combining CNN, LSTM, and BERT embeddings. Methodology: Created a dataset of 40,911 Bengali posts with high annotation quality (Cohen’s Kappa = 0.85). Employed CNN for local pattern recognition, LSTM for temporal dependencies, and BERT embeddings for feature extraction.
